evidence.detail: R145 ClientSidebarPanel constructs exactly one rs/gui/L and installs it on the panel's JTabbedPane through addChangeListener.
rs/gui/L implements javax.swing.event.ChangeListener, casts the ChangeEvent source to JTabbedPane and reads the selected tab index on every state change.
After a tab selection change the listener calls Launcher.n().d(); Launcher.d() is the shared sidebar/window follow-up callback. The class owns no unrelated state or input behavior.

candidates.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the ChangeListener installed on ClientSidebarPanel's tabbed pane. The downstream Launcher.d() effect is not overinterpreted.
